conflicts.resolution: Quattro Q2 and FY2024 launched populations differ; both dated snapshots retained. No subtraction presented as comparable sales flows.
Hotel opening reports retain native date semantics and superseded targets; they do not establish residential occupancy.

excludedCandidates.reason: Brochure and developer timeline distinguish phases but catalogue lacks a discriminating identity; Gateway II financials and original Gateway delivery are not attached to the project.
South-labelled brochure filename has generic Bay content; no verified South-to-Phase-II mapping. Both Bay financial rows remain unassigned.
Generic name remains ambiguous between original villas and 80-home Granada Extension. No 2010 delivery or extension financials assigned to this project.

2024 and 2025 audited statements report portfolio totals and valuation-input ranges without exact catalogue property identities. No allocation to projects or communities, per-unit division or current valuation credit.
Direct operator capture failed; no source or coverage credit. Exact Anantara opening date is separately supported by reviewed developer report.

methodology: Visually reviewed native table and timeline, checksummed primary captures, exact identity proofs and separately preserved reporting vintages. No average prices, registered sale inference, aggregate portfolio valuation allocation, NIL-to-zero conversion, hotel-to-residence fan-out or inferred historical online availability.
